description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Pheres-Band Tromper, targeting Pheres-Band Tromper.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
